name: gallery
description: The Photo Gallery's domain: albums, photographs, favourites, sharing and smart-collection windows, saved as JSON in the app's data home. Every page plugin injects it.
mount: a row `- id: gallery` / `name: gallery` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `gallery` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default photo-gallery.json)
config.store: a Store port for tests (default: one JSON file under the app's home)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests (default: the system clock)
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests (default: a random UUID suffix)
